CustomField.description: Performance threshold in milliseconds for this action. When set, a run that takes that long or longer is logged, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. It wins over the threshold of the action's trigger setting and over Trigger Performance Threshold (ms) in Log Setting. 0 logs every run. A very high number stops the entries for this action. Leave blank to use the trigger setting's threshold, or Log Setting when the trigger setting has none. Suppress Performance Logging and Force Performance Logging win over this value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Log a run of this action that takes this many milliseconds or longer, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Wins over the trigger setting's threshold. Blank uses the trigger setting's threshold, or Log Setting when that is blank too.
CustomField.label: Performance Threshold (ms)
